patthana20.8:1.1: pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.

patthana20.8:3.1: na dassanena pahātabbañca na na dassanena pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.

patthana20.8:7.1: na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.8:9.1: na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.8:11.1: na savitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na savitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na savitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko ca avitakko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.8:12.1: na avitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na avitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na avitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko ca avitakko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana20.8:13.1: na savitakkañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savikko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na savitakkañca avitakkañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na savitakkañca na avitakkañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko ca avitakko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana20.8:15.1: na savicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.8:17.1: na sappītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.8:19.1: na pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.8:21.1: na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.8:23.1: na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato ca na upekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.8:24.1: na na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.8:25.1: na upekkhāsahagatañca na na upekkhāsahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na upekkhāsahagatañca na na upekkhāsahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na upekkhāsahagatañca na na upekkhāsahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato ca na upekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. tīṇita
patthana20.8:27.1: na kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kāmāvacaro ca na kāmāvacaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,

patthana20.8:29.1: kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. na kāmāvacarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.8:31.1: na rūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca rūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,

patthana20.8:37.1: na pariyāpannañca na apariyāpannañca dhammaṃ paṭicca pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:39.1: na niyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:40.1: na aniyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.8:41.1: na niyyānikañca na aniyyānikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:43.1: na niyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:44.1: na aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.8:45.1: na niyatañca na aniyatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
